pdfs.bruneau: NOTICE OF SCHEDULE OF REGULAR MEETINGS OF THE BOARD OF TRUSTEES JOINT SCHOOL DISTSRICT NO. 365 ELMORE-OWYHEE COUNTY, IDAHO NOTICE IS HEREBY GIVEN, that the regular meeting of the Board of Trustees of Joint School District No. 365, Bruneau Grand View, will be held for the conduct of business at 7 p.m. at Rimrock School Library on the following Tuesdays of each month through January 2027 unless the Board duly cancels such regular meeting or, by resolution and written notice, changes the day of the week designated for regular meetings of the Board. February 10, 2026 (1 p.m. Rimrock) March 10, 2026 (1 p.m. Grand View School) April 14, 2026 May 12, 2026 June 09, 2026 (Budget Hearing) July 14, 2026 August 11, 2026 September 8, 2026 October 13, 2026 November 10, 2026 (1 p.m. Bruneau Elementary School) December 08, 2026 January 12, 2027 (Annual Meeting) PUBLIC PLACES FOR POSTING OF PUBLIC NOTICES The public places for the posting of public notices from Joint School District No. 365 Are designated as: Rimrock School –District Administrative Office www@sd365.us District Website Courtesy Postings-Bruneau Elementary-Grand View Elementary Said regular meetings of the Board of Trustees are held pursuant to Section 33-510, Idaho Code. Dated the 13 th day of January 2026 JayDene Aquiso Business Manager/Clerk Joint School District No. 365 Elmore and Owyhee Counties
